editorial:
The Shadow (1940) is Columbia Pictures' 15-chapter cliffhanger serial starring Victor Jory as a masked crimefighter. A creator would want it for the serial format: fifteen chapters, each ending on a cliffhanger, with masked-vigilante action that is easy to clip, riff on or build a series around.

The copyright status is not established. I could not confirm a renewal entry for any chapter in the 1967 Catalog of Copyright Entries, and each of the 15 chapters is a separate registration that needs its own check, including the 1968 volume. Do not treat the serial as free to reuse until each chapter is cleared. The soundtrack, the underlying character and any trademark are separate questions that remain open.
faq: Is the 1940 Columbia serial The Shadow in the public domain?

Undetermined. Renewal was not confirmed for any chapter in the 1967 Catalog of Copyright Entries volume checked. Each of the 15 chapters is a separate registration, so check each one in the 1967 and 1968 volumes and the Copyright Office records before reusing it.
Does an Internet Archive upload mean I can reuse The Shadow?
No. A posted copy does not show the film is free. Reuse depends on each chapter's renewal record. The soundtrack, the character and any trademark are separate questions.
